description: This is a modern sofa bed with a contemporary design. It features a grey upholstered seat and backrest, with a darker grey upholstered section in the middle that appears to be the back of the sofa when used as seating, or the headboard/footboard when converted into a bed. The frame is constructed from black metal, providing a sturdy and industrial look. The overall design is minimalist and functional, suitable for small spaces or multi-purpose rooms. The visible handle on the back suggests it might be designed for easy conversion between sofa and bed modes.
